scenarios.title: Engagement Analysis
scenarios.event: User asks to analyze their last 10 posts' engagement metrics (likes, comments, restacks) and identify what content type performs best

scenarios.title: Content Gap Discovery
scenarios.event: User wants to find topics their audience cares about that they haven't written about yet, based on network trends and comment patterns

scenarios.title: Publishing Schedule Optimization
scenarios.event: User publishes randomly and wants a data-driven publishing schedule based on when their audience is most engaged

scenarios.title: Network Trend Analysis
scenarios.event: User wants to understand what topics are trending across their Substack network (recommendations, restacks) to ride emerging waves

scenarios.title: Content Remix
scenarios.event: User has a high-performing post and wants to create variations (thread, notes, newsletter) to maximize reach across formats

scenarios.title: Subscriber Growth Strategy
scenarios.event: User has 500 free subscribers and wants a plan to convert 10% to paid, using engagement data to identify most-convertible audience segments

scenarios.title: Cold Start — New Publication
scenarios.event: User just started a Substack with 0 posts and 0 subscribers. No historical data exists. Skill should provide bootstrapping guidance

scenarios.title: Cross-Platform Content Strategy
scenarios.event: User publishes on Substack and wants to understand how to repurpose content for other platforms using available tools

criteria: Data Grounding: Does the skill's guidance reference specific metrics from MCP tools (engagement rates, comment sentiment, network trends) rather than generic advice?
Actionability: Does the skill produce concrete next steps with timelines, not vague recommendations?
Audience Awareness: Does the skill consider the specific audience's behavior patterns rather than generic Substack advice?
Tool Utilization: Does the skill reference specific MCP capabilities (analyze-engagement, discover-gaps, analyze-network-trends, generate-content-calendar) by name?
Measurement: Does the skill define success metrics that can be verified using MCP data after implementation?
Adaptation: Does the skill handle edge cases (cold start, declining engagement, niche topics) with different strategies?
